<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/> .
@prefix unit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/> .

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
# Shape for a ship that must have a bottom‑region / lower‑region
# boundary point whose shell inclination angle is exactly 7 deg.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------
_:ShipBoundaryShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:hasBottomRegionLowerRegionBoundaryPoint ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:node _:HullBoundaryPointShape ;
        sh:message "A ship must have at least one bottom‑region / lower‑region boundary point." ;
    ] .

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
# Shape for the hull boundary point linked from the ship.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------
_:HullBoundaryPointShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:hullBoundaryPoint ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:shellInclinationAngle ;
        sh:minCount 1 ;
        sh:node _:ShellInclinationQuantityShape ;
        sh:message "The hull boundary point must have a shell inclination angle." ;
    ] .

# -----------------------------------------------------------------
# Shape for the QuantityValue that encodes the shell inclination angle.
# The value must be 7 deg.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------
_:ShellInclinationQuantityShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass qudt:QuantityValue ;
    # numeric value = 7
    sh:property [
        sh:path qudt:numericValue ;
        sh:datatype xsd:decimal ;
        sh:hasValue "7"^^xsd:decimal ;
        sh:message "Shell inclination angle numeric value must be 7." ;
    ] ;
    # unit must be degree
    sh:property [
        sh:path qudt:unit ;
        sh:hasValue unit:DEG ;
        sh:message "Shell inclination angle unit must be degree (deg)." ;
    ] .
<END_SHACL>
